answers.how: Measured the full trophy height at about 194 px and the basketball diameter at 48.5 px; 194 × 0.282 / 48.5.
Measured a small window pane's horizontal length at about 89 px; 89 × 0.282 / 48.5.
Measured a small window pane's height at about 69 px; 69 × 0.282 / 48.5.
Measured the green wall section's height at about 207 px; 207 × 0.282 / 48.5.
Fitted the ball's vertical positions around 0.5 s, obtaining about 172 px/s; converted using 0.282 m per 48.5 px.
A quadratic fit to the descending ball positions gives about 344 px/s²; converted using the basketball diameter.
Fitted the ball's vertical positions around 1.5 s, obtaining about 172 px/s upward; converted using the basketball diameter.
A quadratic fit to the ascending ball positions gives about 320 px/s²; 320 × 0.282 / 48.5.
